description: Source code for implementing Code 39 barcode generation, including classes for standard and extended Code 39 barcodes, with encoding and validation methods.

classes.name: _Code39Base
classes.description: Base class for Code 39 barcode, providing common properties and decompose method.

classes.name: Standard39
classes.description: Class for standard Code 39 barcode, encoding only alphanumeric characters.

classes.name: Extended39
classes.description: Class for extended Code 39 barcode, supporting additional characters via pair encoding.

methods.name: _encode39
methods.description: Function to encode a string into Code 39 barcode pattern, optionally including checksum.

methods.name: decompose
methods.description: Method in _Code39Base to generate barcode pattern string from encoded data.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Method in Standard39 and Extended39 to validate input value characters.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Method in Standard39 and Extended39 to generate barcode encoding from validated value.
